faq.seoDesc: Answers to the most important questions about your driving training at Fahrschule Metropol in Bremen, Garbsen and Hannover.
faq.subtitle: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.heroText: Everything you need to know about your driving training.
faq.moreQuestions: Still have questions? We're happy to help!
faq.q1: How do I register at Fahrschule Metropol?
faq.a1: You can register directly via our online form or visit us at one of our branches in Bremen, Garbsen or Hannover. We need a valid ID and a passport photo.
faq.q2: How long does the driving training take?
faq.a2: The duration depends on the license class and your availability. On average, a Class B license takes 2–4 months. With our intensive course, also in 2–3 weeks.
faq.q3: What payment methods does Fahrschule Metropol offer?
faq.a3: We offer cash payment and bank transfer. Feel free to ask about individual payment options.
faq.q4: Can I do the theory lessons online?
faq.a4: Yes, we offer hybrid theory courses – both on-site and online. So you can learn flexibly, whenever and wherever it suits you.
faq.q5: What happens if I don't pass the exam?
faq.a5: No problem! We prepare you with additional practice sessions and register you for the exam again. About 98% of our students pass on the first or second attempt.
faq.q6: Do you offer intensive or holiday courses?
faq.a6: Yes, at all three locations we offer intensive courses. This way you can get your license in just 2–3 weeks – ideal for students.
faq.q7: At what age can I get my license?
faq.a7: For Class B, you can start theory 6 months before your 17th birthday (BF17). You can find the exact minimum ages on our license classes page.
faq.q8: At which locations is Fahrschule Metropol represented?
faq.a8: We are available in Hannover (Engelbosteler Damm 1), Garbsen (Planetenring 25–27) and Bremen (Bahnhofsplatz 41).

aufbauseminar.seoTitle: Advanced Seminar (ASF) for Novice Drivers | Fahrschule Metropol
aufbauseminar.seoDesc: Advanced seminar for novice drivers during probation – mandatory for violations. Small groups, experienced seminar leaders.
aufbauseminar.whenRequired: When Is an Advanced Seminar Required?
aufbauseminar.whenDesc: An advanced seminar becomes mandatory for novice drivers during their probation period when a so-called A-violation or two B-violations occur. These are traffic offenses classified as dangerous or negligent. The driver licensing authority orders the seminar, which must be completed within a set deadline (usually two months).
aufbauseminar.aViolationsDesc: A single A-violation directly leads to mandatory participation in the ASF. Typical A-violations include:
aufbauseminar.aViolationsNote: Additionally, the probation period is extended to 4 years.
aufbauseminar.bViolationsDesc: Two B-violations within the probation period also serve as grounds for a mandatory ASF. These include:
aufbauseminar.bViolationsNote: A single B-violation initially has no consequences.
aufbauseminar.mpuDesc1: An MPU (medical-psychological examination) is generally not necessary after an advanced seminar. It is only ordered directly in particularly severe cases – e.g., drunk driving.
aufbauseminar.mpuDesc2: However, anyone who commits further violations after the ASF risks losing their license and may need to undergo an MPU later.
aufbauseminar.smallGroupsDesc: Maximum 12 participants per seminar for personal support and open conversations.
aufbauseminar.experiencedLeadersDesc: Our certified seminar leaders ensure a constructive and respectful atmosphere.
aufbauseminar.contactDesc: Received mail from the driver licensing authority? Contact us – we'll help you quickly and discreetly.
